RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Residential Lease Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into by and between Willowbrook Rentals LLC ("Landlord") and the undersigned tenant ("Tenant") for the premises located at 220 Larkspur Lane, Unit 4, Riverton ("Premises").

1. TERM. The initial term of this Agreement shall begin on June 1 and shall end on May 31 of the following year (the "Initial Term"). Tenant shall have no right to occupy the Premises before the start date without Landlord's prior written consent.

2. RENT. Tenant shall pay Landlord monthly rent of $1,850.00, due on the first day of each calendar month. Rent may be paid by check, direct deposit, or through the Landlord's optional online tenant portal at no additional charge. A payment received after the fifth day of the month is considered late and subject to the late fee described in Section 3.

3. LATE FEES. If rent is not received by the fifth day of the month, Tenant shall pay a one-time late fee of $50.00 for that month. No other recurring charges apply beyond the rent stated in Section 2 unless separately agreed to in writing by both parties.

4. SECURITY DEPOSIT. Tenant shall pay a security deposit of $1,850.00 prior to move-in. Within twenty-one days after Tenant vacates the Premises, Landlord shall return the security deposit, less any amount reasonably necessary to repair damage beyond normal wear and tear or to cover unpaid rent, together with an itemized written statement describing each deduction and its cost. Normal wear and tear, meaning the ordinary deterioration that results from intended use of the Premises over time, shall not be deducted from the security deposit.

5. RENEWAL. This Agreement shall end automatically at the conclusion of the Initial Term unless Tenant and Landlord both agree in writing to a new term at least thirty (30) days before the Initial Term ends. Landlord shall provide Tenant with written notice at least sixty (60) days before the end of the Initial Term describing the renewal options available, and this Agreement shall not renew or convert to a new fixed term without Tenant's affirmative written agreement.

6. USE OF PREMISES. The Premises shall be used solely as a private residence for Tenant and Tenant's immediate household as listed on the application. Tenant shall comply with all applicable building rules, occupancy limits, and municipal codes.

7. MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS. Tenant shall keep the Premises in a clean and sanitary condition and shall promptly notify Landlord of any needed repairs. Landlord shall maintain the structural components, plumbing, heating, and electrical systems of the Premises in good working order, consistent with applicable housing codes. Tenant shall be responsible for replacing light bulbs and HVAC filters during the tenancy.

8. ALTERATIONS. Tenant shall not make any alterations, including painting, installing shelving, or modifying fixtures, without Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld for minor, reversible alterations.

9. RIGHT OF ENTRY. Landlord may enter the Premises for inspection, repairs, or to show the unit to prospective tenants or buyers after providing Tenant with at least twenty-four hours' written or verbal notice, except in the case of a genuine emergency threatening life or property, in which case Landlord may enter without prior notice. Entries shall occur only at reasonable times of day.

10. GUESTS. Tenant may host guests at reasonable times without prior approval. A guest who stays for more than fourteen consecutive days, or more than twenty days total in any calendar year, shall be discussed with Landlord and may require an update to the lease, but ordinary overnight and weekend visits are not restricted or subject to any fee.

11. PETS. Tenant may keep up to two normal household pets on the Premises, subject to a refundable pet deposit of $300 and Landlord's standard pet policy, a copy of which is attached as Addendum A.

12. EARLY TERMINATION. Should Tenant need to terminate this Agreement before the end of the then-current term, Tenant shall provide Landlord with at least thirty (30) days' written notice and shall remain responsible for rent only until the earlier of the end of that notice period or the date Landlord re-rents the Premises to a new tenant, plus a lease-break fee equal to one month's rent. Landlord shall make reasonable, good-faith efforts to re-rent the Premises promptly in order to minimize the rent owed by Tenant under this section.

13. UTILITIES. Tenant is responsible for electricity and gas serving the Premises; Landlord is responsible for water, sewer, and trash service. Tenant shall establish utility accounts in Tenant's own name within five days of move-in.

14. INSURANCE. Tenant is strongly encouraged, but not required, to maintain a renter's insurance policy covering personal property and liability during the term of this Agreement.

15. QUIET ENJOYMENT. Landlord covenants that Tenant, upon paying rent and performing all covenants of this Agreement, shall peaceably and quietly hold and enjoy the Premises for the term of this Agreement, subject to the terms set forth herein, including Section 9.

16. SUBLETTING AND ASSIGNMENT. Tenant shall not sublet the Premises or assign this Agreement without Landlord's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.

17. DEFAULT. If Tenant fails to pay rent when due or otherwise breaches any provision of this Agreement, Landlord may pursue all remedies available under applicable law, including termination of this Agreement and recovery of possession of the Premises after providing any notice required by law.

18. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the state in which the Premises is located.

19. ENTIRE AGREEMENT. This Agreement, together with any addenda referenced herein, constitutes the entire agreement between the parties and supersedes all prior negotiations, representations, or agreements, whether written or oral.

20. SIGNATURES. By signing below, Tenant acknowledges having read and understood all provisions of this Agreement, including the sections governing fees, renewal, security deposit, entry, guests, and early termination, and agrees to be bound by its terms.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Agreement as of the date first written above.
